model_interpretation.claim: A CTA can cooperatively load each 256-source tile's x, y, z, and mass once into shared memory, letting the existing one-thread-per-target mapping reuse those values across target threads. This may reduce repeated global source loads, though barriers and shared-memory traffic may offset the benefit, especially at small sizes.
